__provenance__.statement: THIS FILE IS SYNTHESISED FROM A DOCUMENT AND IS NOT A CAPTURE. It was written by reading docs/opnsense-api-survey.md, never by recording a response from an OPNsense firewall. Cycle 4A cannot reach one: credentials are entered in opnview's own interface, which is cycle 4B. If the survey is wrong about a field, an envelope or a status code, the tests that read this file pass and the collection is still wrong. Do not treat this file as evidence.
__provenance__.survey_section: Data source 1 - Filter logs, Response shape
__provenance__.field_list_from: rulenr, subrulenr, anchorname, rid, interface, reason, action, dir, ipversion, __digest__, __host__, __timestamp__, __spec__, label, tos, ecn, ttl, id, offset, ipflags, protonum, protoname, length, src, dst, srcport, dstport, datalen, tcpflags, seq, ack, urp, tcpopts
__provenance__.why_these_values: A JSON array, newest first, as the survey says this endpoint returns rather than an envelope. Five records exercising the cases the model names: a device the interface map knows and one it does not; a rid that matches a discovered rule and one that matches none; both address families; an ISO __timestamp__ (the form measured on a live firewall) and a year-less one (the form the survey says remains possible); a blocked record and passed ones; and an action and a direction outside their vocabularies, which must become unknown.
__provenance__.example_values_are_not_a_network: Every identifier, device name and address below is synthesised for this fixture. None of them describes anyone's network, and no code under test presupposes any of them: each is read back out of this file.
